BluePearl Pet Hospital Golden Valley – serving the twin cities.
We are located in Golden Valley, convenient to downtown Minneapolis and the surrounding communities and suburbs.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care in case of a pet emergency. If your pet needs advanced veterinary care, we are ready for that too.
Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
Call ahead to let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for emergency care.
Learn more about your emergency visit.
Referral care
Our veterinarians work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our veterinarians are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Golden Valley.
We strive to match the quality and integrity of animal healthcare with that of human healthcare, and our hospital's state-of-the-art equipment reflects that vision. Our 15,000-square-foot Golden Valley pet hospital has the equipment and staff to give your pets the advanced emergency and referral medical care they deserve.
We care for your pets as if they were our own and tailor every treatment according to their specific needs. We offer an intensive care unit, blood transfusions, C-Arm for placing stents, laparoscopy, arthroscopy, and advanced diagnostic imaging technology, which includes ultrasound, endoscopy, MRI, and a 64-slice CT scanner.
Our exam rooms are bright, spacious and comfortable, with separate waiting areas for dogs and cats, an isolated exit and entry for pets with contagious illnesses, and a private comfort room. We always have a veterinarian on staff as our emergency vet services are offered 24 hours a day, seven days a week, including all holidays.

Testimonials.
When our Doberman was struck in our own driveway, everything happened in a blur. One moment he was by our side, and the next we were rushing him to BluePearl, terrified of what we might lose. From the moment we arrived at the St. Cloud location, we were met with calm urgency, compassion, and a level of professionalism that immediately reassured us we were in the right place.
Our dog had suffered multiple broken ribs and a pneumothorax—serious, life-threatening injuries. After initial stabilization, we were transferred to the Golden Valley hospital for critical care. Though the situation was overwhelming, the transition was seamless, and every step of the way we felt informed and supported.
Over the course of three days in critical care, the team not only treated his injuries with expertise, but cared for him—and us—with genuine kindness. Every staff member we encountered, from the front desk to the technicians to the veterinarians, took the time to explain, comfort, and guide us through each decision. It never felt routine to them; it felt deeply personal.
As someone who works in emergency medicine for humans, I see high-pressure care environments every day. What stood out to me at BluePearl was not only their clinical excellence, but the way they delivered it—with empathy, communication, and respect. I found myself taking mental notes, inspired to bring some of that same approach back into my own practice.
Today, our Doberman is home, healed, and doing wonderfully. We are beyond grateful—not just for the outcome, but for the experience of being cared for by such an exceptional team during one of the most frightening moments we’ve faced.
Thank you for giving our dog a second chance, and for reminding us what truly great care looks like.

~Ashley S.
My dog Louie started vomiting and stopped eating. After three visits, bloodwork, x-rays, and ultrasound, our family vet referred me to BluePearl. I can’t praise the ICU vets at BluePearl Golden Valley enough for their compassion and the excellent care my dog received. He spent 5 nights in the ICU. They treated Louie, who digested some unknown toxin that almost killed him. All of his numbers were off the charts. His bilirubin was so high he turned yellow. His liver enzymes kept going up. I kept asking if there was any chance of his getting better and they kept reassuring me he would!
The ICU docs called me with updates multiple times a day/night. They explained what they were doing to lower his numbers and how he was reacting to the treatments. When he was being taken care of by the internal medicine vet, she spent 20 minutes explaining his current lab results, what was happening and what they expected to happen.
It’s now 6 weeks later and Louie is 100%. He’s eating normally, singing, playing with my other dog, and his skin is back to pink. I’m so happy he’s recovered.
If you have a pet emergency, I highly recommend BluePearl in Golden Valley.
